learning_outcomes.text: Acquire the skills necessary to be a successful engineer, specifically non-technical (soft) skills.
Develop aspects of 'know-how-to-be' (interpersonal / human component) to complement technical 'know-how'.
Improve verbal, nonverbal communication and active listening.
Prepare, organize, write (and present) a communication using appropriate tools.
Recognize and apply the principles of leadership.
Develop self-motivation and promote motivation in others.
Manifest ethics and deontology in developed actions.

syllabus_topics: The importance of soft skills for the current labor market - the specific case of engineering
Soft skills: leadership and team management

assessment_methods.method: Work done throughout the semester (mostly in class)
